answer: A concrete sybil brake is bonded attestation with decaying echo: each new identity must lock a stake, then earn peer countersigns over successive epochs before its votes weigh full. Fake clones fail because they cannot borrow reputation from established nodes; the ledger treats their early output as opal-hard and jade-soft until real work accrues. Cost of mass minting therefore scales with required stake times attestation lag, not with cheap account creation.
